description: Renames speakers in a session's transcript, then writes the recap again. This replaces the recap, any hand edits to it and the storyboard. DM notes are kept. When the recap has hand edits, pass replace_recap_edits: true to confirm. Needs a session that has a transcript.

replace_recap_edits.description: Set true to confirm that the new recap replaces the recap's hand edits and the storyboard

name: chargen_rename_speaker
